description: This file defines the React component 'AdhocFilterControl' for managing and rendering ad-hoc filters in the Superset frontend, including filter options, rendering, and interactions.

classes.name: AdhocFilterControl
classes.description: React component for managing ad-hoc filters, including rendering filter options, handling user interactions, and fetching table metadata.

methods.name: optionsForSelect
methods.description: Generates filter options for select input based on columns and selected metrics.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches table metadata to determine partition columns if applicable.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates filter options and values when props change.

methods.name: removeFilter
methods.description: Removes a filter at a specified index.

methods.name: onRemoveFilter
methods.description: Handles filter removal with canDelete validation.

methods.name: onNewFilter
methods.description: Adds a new filter to the state.

methods.name: getMetricExpression
methods.description: Retrieves the expression string for a saved metric.

methods.name: mapOption
methods.description: Converts a filter option into an AdhocFilter object.

methods.name: addNewFilterPopoverTrigger
methods.description: Wraps a trigger element with the AdhocFilterPopoverTrigger component.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the filter control UI, including filter labels and add button.
